results.protocol: CIFAR-10: 10,000 train images, 1,000/class sampled with numpy RandomState(0), sorted indices; all 10,000 test images. Eval mode, standard model input normalization, no augmentation. Conv sites: flattened maps and spatial channel means; pool/logits appear once under flat (gap omits them). Each view subtracts fit mean then L2-normalizes rows, with the same fit mean used for test. Closed-form ridge on one-hot targets, no intercept, objective ||XW-Y||_F^2 + lambda||W||_F^2. Fit-only multi-output GCV = (RSS/(n*10))/(1-tr(H)/n)^2, float64 eigensolve, dual when d>n. Lambda: 181-point logarithmic scan from max(eigmax,1)*exp(-24) to max(eigmax,1)*exp(12), bounded scalar refinement of all sampled interior minima; boundaries checked. Weighted cosine kNN k=20, votes exp(cos/0.07). Fit diagnostics: exact median distance to 15th nonself neighbour and exact median over all nonself pairs; cosine distances in float32, midpoint medians. No test labels used in fitting or lambda selection. In schema v2, GAP at pool/logits is an alias of flat (these sites already have no spatial dimensions).
